_readme: Hand-checked expectations. 'ids' = substrings identifying the expected listing in the result URL (Flipkart pid, Croma /p/<id>, Myntra product id). Stock is a snapshot taken 2026-11-11 from the captured pages. 'pending' cases are listed for future capture and are not run.

flipkart.note: Flipkart pid MOBHKGAPHZHYA5GQ = Galaxy S26 Ultra 12/512 Sky Blue, InStock. Traps on the same itm: Black/White/Cobalt Violet 512 and 256GB variants; S26 (non-Ultra) Sky Blue 512 (MOBHKGAPAZ3N7GNF); back-panel accessories.

croma.note: Croma lists S26 Ultra 12/512 Sky Blue twice (327248, 321503; same SM-S948BLBCINS + EAN) - one product, in stock. Traps: 256GB Sky Blue (327243, 321491), S26 12/512 Sky Blue (327230, 321485).

flipkart.note: Searches 'samsung galaxy s26 plus 12gb 512gb black', 'samsung galaxy s26 plus', 'galaxy s26+ 5g', 'samsung s26 plus mobile' return S26 / S26 Ultra / S26 FE / S25 Plus handsets and S26+ back panels/lens guards, no S26+ handset.

croma.note: Croma searches 'samsung galaxy s26 plus 12gb 512gb black' and 'samsung galaxy s26 plus' return only S22/S23/S23 Ultra/Z Fold4 (adjacent-model noise, spec section 11).

flipkart.note: Flipkart pid MOBHHNF53GG7JW7S = OnePlus 15 5G 12/256 Infinite Black, CPH2745, availability OutOfStock. Traps: OnePlus N6 / Nord 6 / Nord CE6 (Lite) listings.

croma.note: Croma 323981 = OnePlus 15 12/256 Infinite Black, in_stock false. Same model code CPH2745 for 12/256 Sand Storm (323985, in stock), 12/256 Ultra Violet (323986), 16/512 Infinite Black (323990) - colour and storage traps.

flipkart.note: Flipkart pid TVSHMYS2G69WGGAK: spec Model Name 55NU870BPLA, 139 cm (55 inch), Black, InStock. Traps: other LG 55" TVs (55UA83506LA, 55UA82006LA, QNED65/82/8XA, OLED C5/C6, UR7500, UQ7550).

croma.note: Croma 323497 'LG NU870B 139.7 cm (55 inch)', Model Number 55NU870BPLA, in stock. Traps: NU885, QNED70/82, UQ80, UR75, evo AI 55" models (other model numbers).
